name: Free
overview: Scripture reveals that true freedom is found in knowing the truth of Christ, who liberates believers from bondage and unites them beyond social distinctions such as Jew or Greek, slave or free. This liberty is not merely external but a spiritual reality to be firmly maintained, as emphasized in Galatians where believers are called to stand fast in the freedom Christ provides. The freedom spoken of goes beyond physical circumstances, pointing to a profound transformation and release that comes through Christ alone.
